# cloudxino_dns_zone (Data Source)

A hosted DNS zone, by `id` or `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudxino_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `nameservers` (List of String)
- `status` (String)
